response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, with notable strengths in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure (AWS CDK), and leadership in dev-ops and team mentorship. However, his direct experience with C++ is limited to early roles and lacks recent, high-scale infrastructure leadership. While he demonstrates technical breadth, he does not meet the minimum 8 years of C++ experience or 5 years of large-scale infrastructure leadership required for this role.
strengths: Strong leadership and mentorship experience across multiple teams and domains
Proven ability to build and scale distributed systems and infrastructure (e.g., GISCollective, micro-services at dunnhumby)
Demonstrated expertise in cloud technologies (AWS CDK, CI/CD, Kubernetes) and software architecture
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience (only 1 year in early career, none in last 10 years)
No direct experience with compute hardware architecture or storage systems as required
Lacks 5 years of large-scale infrastructure leadership experience in a mid-senior technical lead role
